note: Built from the official trophy descriptions and the cited guides. Times are the guides' estimates: about 200 hours in total, difficulty 4 out of 10.

stages.text: There are no difficulty settings and no mission replay, and there is no New Game Plus, so one careful playthrough is the whole plan. The game has 15 manual save slots plus one autosave: keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission, and rotate the rest. Never use cheats on your trophy save, because cheats disable trophies and saving. All 55 trophies are single-player and offline, so nothing here can expire with a server.
stages.title: Step 0 — Set up one careful playthrough

stages.text: Play the opening missions and progress through Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning; when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation, then complete that meditation before leaving Chapter 1. This is the only potentially missable trophy-related interaction in the game. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission about a fishing challenge, so watch for the purple icon. Start the slow habits now: scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study new animals with binoculars whenever you meet them.
stages.title: Step 1 — Chapter 1: the opening, and the one missable

stages.text: Finish Chapter 2. Switching between Jason and Lucia opens after the Breakfast Run mission, and from then on you can call the other one in as your partner. Moses gives you the Scooter Bros app for registering vehicles, and the Daily Driver mission unlocks the real-estate app for buying the eight garages. Billy's jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and the last meditation spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after this chapter.
stages.title: Step 2 — Chapter 2: two protagonists, new tools

stages.text: Finish Chapter 3. Yasmani's jewelry jobs hand you the Snap Gun for jewelry store robberies, the shooting ranges and Top Fun drone races open up, and Yago's street-racing strand appears. Race Against Yago is time-sensitive, marked with an hourglass, so save first and race it the moment it appears; the strand counts toward the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.
stages.title: Step 3 — Chapter 3: Vice City opens up

stages.text: Finish Chapter 4. The optional mission That's Where The Money Is, near the end of the chapter, opens up the bank vaults: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open, bringing your partner, because you cannot carry all the bags alone. Vault jobs bring four stars straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns the partner trophy for losing a four-star wanted level.
stages.title: Step 4 — Chapter 4: the big scores

stages.text: Finish Chapter 5 and the final mission. Keep your pre-finale manual save before you start it. The final mission earns the second gold trophy, and after the credits the game lets you keep roaming Leonida freely, with everything outside the story still available for cleanup.
stages.title: Step 5 — Chapter 5 and the finale
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

stages.text: Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work the checklist. It only asks for selected portions: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, all 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 of Bret's target decks, 30 of 40 races won and 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals. Clear the robbery rows first; they pay for the garages and gear the other trophies want.
stages.title: Step 6 — After the credits: 100% completion

stages.text: Finish the eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands, the five character finales for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, and the last meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude. Then sweep the remaining free-roam trophies: the jet at VCIA, the Rhino tank, the jewelry store, the armored truck, the nine gangs' operations, the gym for both characters' Strength, and the money totals. When the checklist is empty, Vice Got a Price! pops and the platinum is yours.
stages.title: Step 7 — Cleanup and the platinum
